title: Chapter 1086
paragraphs: Chapter 1086
Episode 255. The Death of Kelliark Zipfel, and....(3)
As if a shell were breaking, the sun energy enveloping the Origin Stone split apart, and from within, the form of Malugia was being revealed.

Her golden hair swept away the verdant green energy of the Holy Land and covered the center of the sea. All the fiercely swirling energies were being pushed back by her energy and were coming to a stop.
Her eyes, which seemed to hold the universe, were facing forward, but everyone present felt as if they had met her gaze.
It was not just a feeling. She was, in reality, gazing at everyone present in this place, and it was a gaze that no one could avoid.
Before the shock of the 33rd dimension Kelliark's power had even subsided, Jin and his companions were witnessing the appearance of another overwhelming being.
It was as if two suns had descended upon the earth.
A pressure that felt like it was incinerating their entire bodies; originally, most of the coalition members should have completely lost consciousness the moment she awoke.
The powerful existence of the Genesis Knights, including Jin, and some of their companions was protecting their allies.
The Genesis Knights were clearly aware of that fact. It was to the extent that even those being protected could vaguely feel it.
'But if Malugia and Kelliark begin their battle in earnest... too many people will die.'
That, even the Genesis Knights could never stop.
It was difficult to even attempt a retreat, as the Golden Fleet's power sources were as good as dead. Even if the power sources were intact, there was no way those two would just let them be.
'Lord Focal and Lady Silkia. Is there no other choice but to rely on their abilities...!'
Jin turned his head to check the location of the two. He could immediately confirm their position outside the front lines where they had retreated, but wherever he looked, Malugia's gaze followed.
Those eyes perfectly saw through Jin's inner self. As if saying, I know what you are thinking, what you are afraid of.
A chill ran down his spine.
A caliber he had never felt from the egos of the Sun God he had faced before; Malugia was truly the genuine incarnation of Kinzelo, of the destructive desires he had possessed.
[You are not the one who called me, Kelliark Zipfel. I am the one who dragged you out from where you were hiding in the crack between dimensions.]
Malugia's low voice echoed across the battlefield. Kelliark shrugged with an expressionless face.
“All the Malugias who have met their death at my hands have said the exact same thing. Did you think you could kill me, now that I have come alone without my trusted retainers or my Origin Stone?”
Kiiiik-!
The moment Kelliark finished speaking, the spaces near Malugia suddenly distorted. Soon, the distorted space was dyed black, but it felt completely different from aura or shadow energy.
As if it were returning space itself to nothingness.
As if it were denying the creation that was at the beginning, denying existence.
That kind of power was erasing the space where Malugia was standing.
No one could explain why an unbearable nausea surged up just from seeing that sight.
People, as living beings, were being overwhelmed by the sight of an absolute malice that blasphemed creation and existence itself.
The hegemon of all dimensions, Kelliark Zipfel.

He was a being who could not be explained by the standards of the mortal world, like immortals or mortals. Even Zito, who was the master of hell and suffering, would be nothing more than a mere powerful immortal compared to him.

“The first time I killed you, I risked my life. The second time I killed you, I suffered from a wound that had not healed even at that moment. But the third time I killed you, you no longer seemed so fearsome, and after that... it was just a job. You could say it was like an act of cleaning.”
Wdeudeuk-! Shiiit...!

The distorted space was now turning into a single lump of darkness. As if someone had erased her with an eraser, half of Malugia's body was buried in that darkness and had disappeared, and she looked even more grotesque due to her hair, which was spread out like islands all over the sea.
Surprisingly, what Kelliark was performing now was magic. A magic that no immortal, no transcendent being, could ever imitate.
Even Jin, Valeria, and Veradin could not understand its formula and the flow of its magic at all.
The three of them, along with the companions most proficient in magic, were pouring all their focus into trying to read this horrific magic.
They had to find even the smallest, dust-speck-like weakness. They couldn't even dare to think of responding vaguely with abilities like the power of existence or recording magic.
It seemed Malugia too could not respond to Kelliark's magic at all. At this rate, she would soon be completely submerged in the darkness and become a being that had never existed in this world.
'Surely Malugia won't end like this. From the moment she first planned this game, she must have prepared some move.'
Jin gave up on analyzing the magic for now and began to prepare for the next situation.

This was not the time to fight anyway, but a moment where they had to retreat somehow and hope for the next chance. If they were to start a full-scale war with Kelliark now, annihilation was a certainty.

Furthermore, Malugia was an ego of destruction; there was no way she would be favorable to the coalition like Focal. Even Bligiet didn't dare to try anything with Malugia using the memory of the beginning.
'For now, I have to use Malugia somehow...!'
To create a situation where Kelliark and Malugia were fighting and then leave the battlefield.
That was the best outcome the coalition could hope for. To do that, first, they had to prevent Malugia from disappearing in vain.
It was certain that Malugia had a hidden card. Because it was unbelievable that she would have appeared thoughtlessly, without gauging the power of the Demon Army and Kelliark Zipfel at all.
However, he could not just wait for that. If he did not move first, he would continue to be swept away.
“Lord Focal.”
Jin called for Focal first, but she was already thinking the exact same thing as Jin. She was already standing next to Jin, having passed through a dimensional gate.
[Jin.]
“Can you open a dimensional gate?”

[A large-scale dimensional gate is a matter for Silkia, not me. The reason I could come to you right now is because I moved alone. Even then, I cannot go outside the battlefield. Not that I intend to run away and leave you all behind.]

According to Focal, Silkia had been looking for a chance to open a large-scale dimensional gate to let the coalition escape since a while ago. However, she was unable to find her bearings because of the great energy flowing like a convection current.
“I understand. In your opinion, Lord Focal, when do you think Malugia will recover?”
[I too can only make a similar guess as you. It does not seem likely that Malugia will just be defeated, but I cannot tell what she is thinking by not recovering.]
“In that case... Lord Focal, is it possible for you to help Malugia right now?”
Focal's eyes widened.
For two opposing egos to help each other. Such a thing had never once happened among the egos of the Sun God.
[Jin, for what purpose?]

“Because it is something no one would expect. Especially Kelliark Zipfel, who is focusing all his attention on Malugia right now. He is ignoring us completely. He has completely ruled out the case of Lord Focal supporting Malugia.”
To somehow create a variable with something Kelliark did not expect. However, he could not know what the result would be.
It was a method that did not align with the direction Jin originally pursued. Because the situation could become even more dangerous.

But this was not the time to consider such things. After all, if Malugia disappeared as things were, it was annihilation; if she didn't disappear, it was ruin; and even if the two beings began to clash, they would suffer a comparable amount of damage.
If he could just avoid all three of those cases, he had to try, no matter how low the probability.

“As Kelliark said, he has been annihilating all the Malugias of all dimensions until now. According to that experience, the Malugia of this world will also end up like that. What Malugia wants is the ultimate apocalypse. But if the Malugia of this world has judged that she cannot achieve that with only herself and the egos of destruction that follow her...”

[...Malugia has judged that she needs temporary reinforcements for the true apocalypse. Therefore, Malugia is conducting a kind of test right now. Whether we will help her in this situation or not. Is that what you wish to say?]
“That is correct.”

Focal let out a deep sigh. It was a story with a sufficient possibility. The power that the leader of the Demon Army was showing on his own now certainly seemed as if it could stand against the Malugia that Focal knew.
If so, it would be difficult for Malugia and the rest of the egos of destruction to achieve the ruin of all dimensions on their own. Having thought that far, Focal eventually nodded her head.

[It is a thing more horrific than annihilation, to use my power for Malugia. However, if it succeeds, I will be able to say that it was truly a fortunate thing that you are here. Because of my hatred for Malugia, I would not have been able to make such a hypothesis.]
Fwooooong...!
A great sun energy began to extend from Focal. Even then, Kelliark did not take his eyes off Malugia.

[I will now send a portion of the power of creation to Malugia. However, just as I feel a revulsion at helping Malugia, it must be a horrific thing for Malugia to accept my power as well. If Malugia truly accepts this power fully and overcomes Kelliark Zipfel's attack, then your hypothesis will become fact.]
Focal's energy began to pour down on Malugia like a shower.

Only then did Kelliark Zipfel flinch for the first time and show a sign of being conscious of Focal. In all the time he had been facing and subjugating the egos of the Sun God of those numerous dimensions, this was the first time such a case had occurred.
“Focal, I never thought you would surprise me like this... this dimension is a bizarre place in many ways.”
The moment Kelliark said that.
Focal let out an unwitting sigh and glared at Malugia. Malugia had accepted Focal's power.
Therefore, she began to 'create' her own body, which had disappeared into the void of the distorted space, and reveal her form again.
And Malugia said this.
[Finally, I can begin the apocalypse.]
